verdict.rationale: Orb is a billing platform with automated behaviors such as dunning retries, alerts, auto-issuance and top-ups, so versioning and rolling back automations is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows only adjacent features: previews before saving subscription edits, manual invoice approval, and an audit trail of plan assignments. None of these is a documented way to version, review, or roll back automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
